resources.string: Enter the Wireless Debugging pairing code without closing its dialog.
Pairs LATERAL_ with the local Android wireless-debugging service.
Controls applications running on an external display.
Enable Developer options, then turn on Wireless debugging so LATERAL_ can provide input.
Turn on Wireless debugging in Developer options so LATERAL_ can provide input.

LATERAL_ needs a one-time pairing with this device.

1. Tap Start pairing here.
2. In Developer options, open Wireless debugging and tap Pair device with pairing code.
3. Leave that dialog open and enter its 6-digit code in the LATERAL_ pairing notification from the notification shade.
